links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease) of ChatGPT pharyngitis patient answers
links.effect: Both ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4.0 required a high educational level; ChatGPT-4.0 was marginally more readable (p < 0.05).
links.quote: Readability scores indicated both versions required a high educational level, with ChatGPT-4.0 showing marginally better readability (p < 0.05).

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of the accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability of ChatGPT-3.5 and 4.0 outputs for pharyngitis patient guides, evaluated by ENT specialists.
